equivariant_total_set_map_no_go.formal_proof: If y=f(x) and f is H27-equivariant, then Stab(x) subset Stab(y). A free target implies Stab(x)=1; every domain orbit has 27 elements. Since 40 and 480 are not divisible by 27, no such total equivariant deterministic set map exists, for ANY H27 action on either source.
equivariant_total_set_map_no_go.group: H27 acts regularly on 27 Schlaefli vertices, so freely on ordered edges and, because |H27| odd, freely on unoriented edges.
equivariant_total_set_map_no_go.what_is_not_ruled_out: Partial/symmetry-breaking maps, coarse-graining, linear equivariant maps between chain modules, stochastic channels, embedding after adding ancillas or changing group action, or genuinely engineered physical interfaces.

uniform_per_basis_acceptance_outcome_att.adversary_capability: A malicious joint coincidence/postselection unit compares Alice and Bob outcomes AFTER measurements and then flags acceptance, while maintaining identical 1/3 overall acceptance on every setting.
uniform_per_basis_acceptance_outcome_att.security_conclusion: PER-BASIS acceptance-rate equality is not sufficient by itself. Herald flag must be generated independently of both secret measurement outcomes (or constrain the full outcome-dependent instrument).
